lourdessanctuary.name: Sanctuary of Lourdes
lourdessanctuary.slogan: Candles, crowds and a quiet grotto on the Gave.
lourdessanctuary.by: Words Bernadette Soubirous reported from the grotto, 25 March 1858

gavarniecirque.name: Cirque de Gavarnie
gavarniecirque.slogan: A stone amphitheatre with a waterfall falling off the rim.
gavarniecirque.line: The Grande Cascade drops about 422 metres, the highest waterfall in mainland France, inside a UNESCO World Heritage cirque.

picdumidi.name: Pic du Midi
picdumidi.slogan: Take the cable car and sleep above the clouds.
picdumidi.line: A weather station began at the Col de Sencours in 1873; the observatory on the 2,877 m summit was founded in 1878.

lourdeschateau.name: Château fort de Lourdes
lourdeschateau.slogan: A rock fortress over the town, full of Pyrenean life.
lourdeschateau.line: Tradition says Charlemagne besieged this castle in 778; it has housed the Musée Pyrénéen since 1921.

tarbesharas.name: Haras de Tarbes
tarbesharas.slogan: Napoleon's stud farm, where the Anglo-Arab horse took shape.
tarbesharas.line: Napoleon founded the stud in 1806, and it became the cradle of the French Anglo-Arab horse.
